EmailTemplate.subject: Get your copy: Pulse on Payments: B2B Payments Outlook
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, Flywire recently surveyed 300 of your finance peers <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/report-pulse-on-payments-2022-b2b-payments-outlook?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> working at companies with both global and US-only based operations about their Accounts Receivable (A/R) and payment processes. It is clear that many businesses today have focused too hard on the Accounts Payable (A/P), taking away much-needed focus on A/R.
Flywire’s latest industry report <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/report-pulse-on-payments-2022-b2b-payments-outlook?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> explores key findings like:
- How A/R processes are holding back profitability - How foreign exchange rates and collections struggles hinder global expansion - Why cybersecurity, integrated technology remain major challenges
One of the most surprising findings in our survey was that 92% of respondents believe they could increase their earnings-per-share (EPS) if they had a better handle on their A/R processes.
Thank you, Josh Easterly
